verses.sloka: अपृच्छत तदा रामो दक्षिणाशाश्रमं मुनिम् ।प्राञ्जलिर्विनयोपेत इदमाह वचो ऽर्थवत् ।। ७.३५.१ ॥
verses.transliteration: apṛcchata tadā rāmo dakṣiṇāśāśramaṁ munim ।prāñjalirvinayopeta idamāha vaco 'rthavat ।। 7.35.1 ॥

translations.english: Then Rama, with folded hands and full of humility, asked the sage (Agastya) in the hermitage of the southern direction, speaking these meaningful words.

verses.sloka: अतुलं बलमेतद्वै वालिनो रावणस्य च ।न त्वेताभ्यां हनुमता समं त्विति मतिर्मम ।। ७.३५.२ ॥
verses.transliteration: atulaṁ balametadvai vālino rāvaṇasya ca ।na tvetābhyāṁ hanumatā samaṁ tviti matirmama ।। 7.35.2 ॥

translations.english: This strength of Vali and Ravana is indeed incomparable, but in my opinion, it is not equal to Hanuman's.
translations.hindi: महाबली राबणपुत्र मेघनाद अत्यन्त कद्ध हुआ और अपनी समस्त राक्षसी सेना को लौटा कर, खयं युद्ध करने को उद्यत हुआ

verses.sloka: शौर्यं दाक्ष्यं बलं धैर्यं प्राज्ञता नयसाधनम् ।विक्रमश्च प्रभावश्च हनूमति कृतालयाः ।। ७.३५.३ ॥
verses.transliteration: śauryaṁ dākṣyaṁ balaṁ dhairyaṁ prājñatā nayasādhanam ।vikramaśca prabhāvaśca hanūmati kṛtālayāḥ ।। 7.35.3 ॥

translations.english: Valor, skill, strength, courage, wisdom, diplomatic ability, prowess, and influence—all these qualities reside in Hanuman.
translations.hindi: प्रबलित आग जिस प्रकार वन की ओर लपकती हे, वैसे ही वह महारथी मेघनाद, इच्छानुसार चलने वाले विशाल रथ पर बैठे देवताओं की सेना पर दोडा

verses.sloka: दृष्ट्वैव सागरं वीक्ष्य सीदन्तीं कपिवाहिनीम् ।समाश्वास्य महाबाहुर्योजनानां शतं प्लुतः ।। ७.३५.४ ॥
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvaiva sāgaraṁ vīkṣya sīdantīṁ kapivāhinīm ।samāśvāsya mahābāhuryojanānāṁ śataṁ plutaḥ ।। 7.35.4 ॥

translations.english: Having observed the ocean and seeing the monkey army despairing, the mighty-armed Hanuman comforted them and then leaped a hundred yojanas across the sea.
translations.hindi: ॥ विविध प्रकार के आयुधो से सुसज्जित मेघनाद को समरभूमि में प्रदेश करते देखते हो, समस्त देवता भाग खड़े हुए

verses.sloka: धर्षयित्वा पुरीं लङ्कां रावणान्तःपुरं तदा ।दृष्ट्वा सम्भाषिता चापि सीता ह्याश्वासिता तथा ।। ७.३५.५ ॥
verses.transliteration: dharṣayitvā purīṁ laṅkāṁ rāvaṇāntaḥpuraṁ tadā ।dṛṣṭvā sambhāṣitā cāpi sītā hyāśvāsitā tathā ।। 7.35.5 ॥

translations.english: Then, having harassed the city of Lanka and Ravana's inner palace, he indeed saw Sita, conversed with her, and thus comforted her.
translations.hindi: उसके सामने. कोई भी खड़ा न रह सका | समस्त देवसेना को भयभीत हो भागते देख उनसे इन्द्र कहने लगे

verses.sloka: सेनाग्रगा मन्त्रिसुताः किङ्करा रावणात्मजः ।एते हनुमता तत्र ह्येकेन वितिपातिताः ।। ७.३५.६ ॥
verses.transliteration: senāgragā mantrisutāḥ kiṅkarā rāvaṇātmajaḥ ।ete hanumatā tatra hyekena vitipātitāḥ ।। 7.35.6 ॥

translations.english: The leaders of the army, the sons of ministers, the attendants, and Ravana's own son—all these were indeed struck down there by Hanuman alone.
translations.hindi: हे देवताओं! तुमको न तो डरना चाहिए न भागना चाहिए | तुम सब लोग लोटो । देखो यह मेरा कभी न हारने बाला पुत्र लड़ने जाता है

verses.sloka: भूयो बन्धाद्विमुक्तेन भाषयित्वा दशाननम् ।लङ्का भस्मीकृता येन पावकेनेव मेदिनी ।। ७.३५.७ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhūyo bandhādvimuktena bhāṣayitvā daśānanam ।laṅkā bhasmīkṛtā yena pāvakeneva medinī ।। 7.35.7 ॥

translations.english: By him, who, having been released from bondage, spoke to Daśānana, Lanka was reduced to ashes, as if the earth itself were consumed by fire.
translations.hindi: इन्द्रनन्द्न जयन्तरेव एक बड़े विलक्षण रथ पर सवार हो समरच्तेत्र में आया

verses.sloka: न कालस्य न शक्रस्य न विष्णोर्वित्तपस्य च ।कर्माणि तानि श्रूयन्ते यानि युद्धे हनूमतः ।। ७.३५.८ ॥
verses.transliteration: na kālasya na śakrasya na viṣṇorvittapasya ca ।karmāṇi tāni śrūyante yāni yuddhe hanūmataḥ ।। 7.35.8 ॥

translations.english: Such deeds as those of Hanumān in battle are not heard of, even from Time (Yama), Indra, Vishnu, or Kubera.
translations.hindi: इति अष2विंशः सग: ॥ ब दोंतों रथी इस प्रक'र युद्ध करते हुए निरन्तर बाज ठी वर्षो करने लगे, तब चारों ओर अन्धकार छा गया । आत उस समय किसी को कुछ भी दिखल्लाई नहीं पड़ता था

verses.sloka: एतस्य बाहुवीर्येण लङ्का सीता च लक्ष्मणः ।प्राप्ता मया जयश्चैव राज्यं मित्राणि बान्धवाः ।। ७.३५.९ ॥
verses.transliteration: etasya bāhuvīryeṇa laṅkā sītā ca lakṣmaṇaḥ ।prāptā mayā jayaścaiva rājyaṁ mitrāṇi bāndhavāḥ ।। 7.35.9 ॥

translations.english: By the valor of Hanumān, I regained Lanka, Sītā, Lakshmaṇa, victory, my kingdom, friends, and relatives.

verses.sloka: हनूमान्यदि मे नः स्याद्वानराधिपतेः सखा ।प्रवृत्तिमपि को वेत्तुं जानक्याः शक्तिमान्भवेत् ।। ७.३५.१० ॥
verses.transliteration: hanūmānyadi me naḥ syādvānarādhipateḥ sakhā ।pravṛttimapi ko vettuṁ jānakyāḥ śaktimānbhavet ।। 7.35.10 ॥

translations.english: If Hanumān, the friend of the lord of monkeys, had not been with me, who would have been capable of even finding news of Janakī?
translations.hindi: की इतने में मेघनाद ने मातलिपुत्र गोसुख (जो जयन्त का रथ हॉक रहा था ) के बहुत से सुवणंभूषित बाण मारे

verses.sloka: किमर्थं वाल्यनेनैव सुग्रीवप्रियकाम्यया ।तदा वैरे समुत्पन्ने न दग्धो वीरुधो यथा ।। ७.३५.११ ॥
verses.transliteration: kimarthaṁ vālyanenaiva sugrīvapriyakāmyayā ।tadā vaire samutpanne na dagdho vīrudho yathā ।। 7.35.11 ॥

translations.english: Why then, when enmity had arisen, was Vāli not burnt by Hanumān, out of a desire to please Sugrīva, just like creepers are burnt?
translations.hindi: RR इसके जवाब सें शचीसुत जयन्त ने मी क्रोध में भर सेघ- नाद क सारथि को और मेघनाद को भी बाण मार कर अली भाति घायल किया

verses.sloka: नहि वेदितवान्मन्ये हनूमानात्मनो बलम् ।यद्दृष्टवाञ्जीवितेष्टं क्लिश्यन्तं वानराधिपम् ।। ७.३५.१२ ॥
verses.transliteration: nahi veditavānmanye hanūmānātmano balam ।yaddṛṣṭavāñjīviteṣṭaṁ kliśyantaṁ vānarādhipam ।। 7.35.12 ॥

translations.english: I believe Hanuman did not know his own strength, because he saw Sugriva, who was dear to him as life, suffering.

verses.sloka: एतन्मे भगवन्सर्वं हनूमति महामतौ ।विस्तरेण यथातत्त्वं कथयामरपूजित ।। ७.३५.१३ ॥
verses.transliteration: etanme bhagavansarvaṁ hanūmati mahāmatau ।vistareṇa yathātattvaṁ kathayāmarapūjita ।। 7.35.13 ॥

translations.english: O revered one, worshipped by gods, please tell me all about the great-minded Hanuman in detail and truly.

verses.sloka: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा हेतुयुक्तमृषिस्तदा ।हनूमतः समक्षं तमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। ७.३५.१४ ॥
verses.transliteration: rāghavasya vacaḥ śrutvā hetuyuktamṛṣistadā ।hanūmataḥ samakṣaṁ tamidaṁ vacanamabravīt ।। 7.35.14 ॥

translations.english: Having heard Rama's reasonable words, the sage then spoke these words to him in Hanuman's presence.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार से मेघनाद शत्रसेन्य पर प्रहार कर रहा था कि, इसी बीच में उसकी साया से चारो ओर अन्धकार छा गया । जिस से त्रिलोकबासी समस्ते प्रजा घबदा उठी

verses.sloka: सत्यमेतद्रघुश्रेष्ठ यद्ब्रवीषि हनूमतः ।न बले विद्यते तुल्यो न गतौ न मतौ परः ।। ७.३५.१५ ॥
verses.transliteration: satyametadraghuśreṣṭha yadbravīṣi hanūmataḥ ।na bale vidyate tulyo na gatau na matau paraḥ ।। 7.35.15 ॥

translations.english: O best of Raghus, what you say about Hanuman is true: there is no one equal to him in strength, speed, or intellect.

verses.sloka: अमोघशापैः शप्तस्तु दत्तो ऽस्य मुनिभिः पुरा ।न वेत्ता हि बलं येन बली सन्निरिमर्दनः ।। ७.३५.१६ ॥
verses.transliteration: amoghaśāpaiḥ śaptastu datto 'sya munibhiḥ purā ।na vettā hi balaṁ yena balī sannirimardanaḥ ।। 7.35.16 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, he was formerly cursed by sages with unfailing curses, by which, though he is strong and a destroyer of foes, he does not know his own strength.
translations.hindi: जयन्त को घेर कर जो देवसेना आयी थी, वह्‌ मेघनाद के बाणों से पीड़ित हो गयो और बहुप्रकार से विकल हो उठी

verses.sloka: बाल्ये ऽप्येतेन यत्कर्म कृतं राम महाबल ।तन्न वर्णयितुं शक्यमिति बालतया ऽ ऽस्यते ।। ७.३५.१७ ॥
verses.transliteration: bālye 'pyetena yatkarma kṛtaṁ rāma mahābala ।tanna varṇayituṁ śakyamiti bālatayā ' 'syate ।। 7.35.17 ॥

translations.english: O mighty Rama, it is impossible to fully describe the deeds performed by him (Hanuman) even in his childhood, as they are beyond words due to his tender age.
translations.hindi: उस समय दोनों ओर की सेना की ऐसी दशा:हो गयी कि, उन्हें अपने बिराने का ज्ञान तक न रह गया कि, यह देवता पक्ष का व्यक्ति है कि राक्षस पक्ष का | युद्धभूमि में जिधर देखो उधर बड़ी दुळ्येवस्था उत्पन्न हो गयी | सब सेनिक घबड़ाते हुए चारों ओर घूमने लगे

verses.sloka: यदि वा ऽस्ति त्वभिप्रायस्तच्छ्रोतुं तव राघव ।समाधाय मतिं राम निशामय वदाम्यहम् ।। ७.३५.१८ ॥
verses.transliteration: yadi vā 'sti tvabhiprāyastacchrotuṁ tava rāghava ।samādhāya matiṁ rāma niśāmaya vadāmyaham ।। 7.35.18 ॥

translations.english: O Raghava, if you indeed have a desire to hear those deeds, then O Rama, concentrate your mind and listen, for I shall narrate them.

verses.sloka: सूर्यदत्तवरस्वर्णः सुमेरुर्नाम पर्वतः ।यत्र राज्यं प्रशास्त्यस्य केसरी नाम वै पिता ।। ७.३५.१९ ॥
verses.transliteration: sūryadattavarasvarṇaḥ sumerurnāma parvataḥ ।yatra rājyaṁ praśāstyasya kesarī nāma vai pitā ।। 7.35.19 ॥

translations.english: There is a mountain named Sumeru, golden due to a boon granted by the Sun, where his (Hanuman's) father, named Kesari, indeed rules.

verses.sloka: तस्य भार्या बभूवैषा ह्यञ्जनेति परिश्रुता ।जनयामास तस्यां वै वायुरात्मजमुत्तमम् ।। ७.३५.२० ॥
verses.transliteration: tasya bhāryā babhūvaiṣā hyañjaneti pariśrutā ।janayāmāsa tasyāṁ vai vāyurātmajamuttamam ।। 7.35.20 ॥

translations.english: His (Kesari's) well-known wife was Anjana, in whom Vayu, the Wind-god, indeed begot an excellent son.
translations.hindi: वह पुलोमा शची का पिता था | अत: बह जयन्त का नाना अपने थेवते को ले समुद्र में घुस गया

verses.sloka: शालिशूकनिभाभासं प्रासूतामुं तदा ऽञ्जना ।फलान्याहर्तुकामा वै निष्क्रान्ता गहनेचरा ।। ७.३५.२१ ॥
verses.transliteration: śāliśūkanibhābhāsaṁ prāsūtāmuṁ tadā 'ñjanā ।phalānyāhartukāmā vai niṣkrāntā gahanecarā ।। 7.35.21 ॥

translations.english: Anjana, who moved in the forest, then gave birth to him (Hanuman), who had a luster like a ripe paddy grain, and she had gone out desiring to gather fruits.
translations.hindi: तब समरभूमि में जयन्त को न देख योर उसे नष्ट हुआ ज्ञान, देवता बड़े दुःखी और व्यथित हो, वहाँ से भाग खड़े हुए

verses.sloka: एष मातुर्वियोगाच्च क्षुधया च भृशार्दितः ।रुरोद शिशुरत्यर्थं शिशुः शरवणे यथा ।। ७.३५.२२ ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣa māturviyogācca kṣudhayā ca bhṛśārditaḥ ।ruroda śiśuratyarthaṁ śiśuḥ śaravaṇe yathā ।। 7.35.22 ॥

translations.english: This child, greatly distressed by separation from his mother and by hunger, cried exceedingly, just like the child Kartikeya in the reed-forest.
translations.hindi: फिर मेघनाद अपनी सेना को साथ लिये हुए क्रोध में भर सिंहनाद करता हुआ देवताओं को खदेड़ने लगा

verses.sloka: तदोद्यन्तं विवस्वन्तं जपापुष्पोत्करोपमम् ।ददर्श फललोभाच्च ह्युत्पपात रविं प्रति ।। ७.३५.२३ ॥
verses.transliteration: tadodyantaṁ vivasvantaṁ japāpuṣpotkaropamam ।dadarśa phalalobhācca hyutpapāta raviṁ prati ।। 7.35.23 ॥

translations.english: Then, he saw the rising sun, which resembled a cluster of hibiscus flowers, and out of a desire for fruit, he indeed flew up towards the sun.
translations.hindi: लड़ते लड़ते वह महाभयानक रुद्रों से जा भिड़ा | रुद्रों के शस्त्रप्रहार से उसका सारा शरीर चलनी हो गया

verses.sloka: बालार्काभिमुखो बालो बालार्क इव मूर्तिमान् ।ग्रहीतुकामो बालार्कं प्लवते ऽम्बरमध्यगः ।। ७.३५.२४ ॥
verses.transliteration: bālārkābhimukho bālo bālārka iva mūrtimān ।grahītukāmo bālārkaṁ plavate 'mbaramadhyagaḥ ।। 7.35.24 ॥

translations.english: The child, facing the morning sun, soared through the middle of the sky like an embodied morning sun, desirous of seizing the sun itself.
translations.hindi: रि € इन्द्र ने अपने पुत्र को बहा न देख तथा दबजाओं को युद्ध छोड़ कर भागते देख; मातलि से कहा -मेरा रथ लाओ ।!२३॥ स तु दिव्यो महाथीमः सञ्ज एव महारथः । उपस्थितो सातलिना बाह्ममानो महाजवः

verses.sloka: एतस्मिन्प्लवमाने तु शिशुभावे हनूमति ।देवदानवयक्षाणां विस्मयः सुमहानभूत् ।। ७.३५.२५ ॥
verses.transliteration: etasminplavamāne tu śiśubhāve hanūmati ।devadānavayakṣāṇāṁ vismayaḥ sumahānabhūt ।। 7.35.25 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, a very great wonder arose among the gods, demons, and yakshas as this child Hanumān soared through the sky.

verses.sloka: नाप्येवं वेगवान्वायुर्गरुडो वा मनस्तथा ।यथा ऽयं वायुपुत्रस्तु क्रमते ऽम्बरमुत्तमम् ।। ७.३५.२६ ॥
verses.transliteration: nāpyevaṁ vegavānvāyurgaruḍo vā manastathā ।yathā 'yaṁ vāyuputrastu kramate 'mbaramuttamam ।। 7.35.26 ॥

translations.english: Neither the wind, nor Garuda, nor even the mind is as swift as this son of Vayu, who indeed traverses the high sky.
translations.hindi: जिस समय इन्द्र, पुरी से निकले; उस समय गन्धर्व लोग | तरह तरह के बाजे बजाते और अप्सराएं रथ के आगे, नाचती जाती थीं

verses.sloka: यदि तावच्छिशोरस्य त्वीदृशो गतिविक्रमः ।यौवनं बलमासाद्य कथं वेगो भविष्यति ।। ७.३५.२७ ॥
verses.transliteration: yadi tāvacchiśorasya tvīdṛśo gativikramaḥ ।yauvanaṁ balamāsādya kathaṁ vego bhaviṣyati ।। 7.35.27 ॥

translations.english: If this child, even in his infancy, possesses such speed and prowess, how much greater will his velocity become when he attains youth and full strength?
translations.hindi: रुद्र, वसु, आदित्य अश्विनीकुमार और मरुद्गण विविध प्रकार के आयुधों को लिये हुए, इन्द्र के रथ को धेर कर चले जाते थे

verses.sloka: तमनुप्लवते वायुः प्लवन्तं पुत्रमात्मनः ।सूर्यदाहभयाद्रक्षंस्तुषारचयशीतलः ।। ७.३५.२८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tamanuplavate vāyuḥ plavantaṁ putramātmanaḥ ।sūryadāhabhayādrakṣaṁstuṣāracayaśītalaḥ ।। 7.35.28 ॥

translations.english: Vayu, the wind god, followed his own son (Hanuman) as he flew, protecting him from the sun's scorching heat by making himself cool with a mass of frost.
translations.hindi: निर्गच्छतस्तु शक्रस्य परुषः पवनो बबों । भास्करो निष्प्रभश्चैव महोल्काऱ्च प्रपेदिरे ॥२ = | इन्द्र की रणयात्रा के समय रूखा हता चलने लगी सुय -प्रभाहीन हो गए और आकाश से महाउल्क। गत हुआ इन्द्र की पराजप्र के ते सत्र सूचक थे

verses.sloka: बहुयोजनसाहस्रं क्रमत्येष गतोम्बरम् ।पितुर्बलाच्च बाल्याच्च भास्कराभ्याशमागतः ।। ७.३५.२९ ॥
verses.transliteration: bahuyojanasāhasraṁ kramatyeṣa gatombaram ।piturbalācca bālyācca bhāskarābhyāśamāgataḥ ।। 7.35.29 ॥

translations.english: This child, having traversed many thousands of yojanas into the sky, reached the vicinity of the sun, driven by his father's strength and his own childish innocence.

verses.sloka: शिशुरेष त्वदोषज्ञ इति मत्वा दिवाकरः ।कार्यं चात्र समायत्तमित्येवं न ददाह सः ।। ७.३५.३० ॥
verses.transliteration: śiśureṣa tvadoṣajña iti matvā divākaraḥ ।kāryaṁ cātra samāyattamityevaṁ na dadāha saḥ ।। 7.35.30 ॥

translations.english: Considering this child to be innocent and realizing that a significant purpose was dependent on him, the sun did not burn him.
translations.hindi: उस रथ में ऐसे बड़े भारी भारी साँप लिपटे हुए थे जिनको देखने से देखने वाले के (मारे भय के ) रोंगटे खड़े हो जाते थे । उन सहाविषधर सर्पो की फुरुक,रों से समरभूमि में उजियाला हो जाता था

verses.sloka: यमेव दिवसं ह्येष ग्रहीतुं भास्करं प्लुतः ।तमेव दिवसं राहुर्जिघृक्षति दिवाकरम् ।। ७.३५.३१ ॥
verses.transliteration: yameva divasaṁ hyeṣa grahītuṁ bhāskaraṁ plutaḥ ।tameva divasaṁ rāhurjighṛkṣati divākaram ।। 7.35.31 ॥

translations.english: On the very day that this child leaped to seize the sun, Rahu also desired to grasp the sun.
translations.hindi: दैत्य ओर राक्षस उस रथ को घेरे हुए थे | रावण का बह दिव्य रथ युद्धभूमि में इन्द्र के रथ के सामने जा डटा

verses.sloka: अनेन स परामृष्टो राम सूर्यरथोपरि ।अपक्रान्तस्ततस्त्रस्तो राहुश्चन्द्रार्कमर्दनः ।। ७.३५.३२ ॥
verses.transliteration: anena sa parāmṛṣṭo rāma sūryarathopari ।apakrāntastatastrasto rāhuścandrārkamardanaḥ ।। 7.35.32 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, when he (the original Rahu), the tormentor of the moon and sun, was touched by that other one upon the sun's chariot, he became frightened and departed from there.

verses.sloka: स इन्द्रभवनं गत्वा सरोषः सिंहिकासुतः ।अब्रवीद्भ्रुकुटिं कृत्वा देवं देवगणैर्वृतम् ।। ७.३५.३३ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa indrabhavanaṁ gatvā saroṣaḥ siṁhikāsutaḥ ।abravīdbhrukuṭiṁ kṛtvā devaṁ devagaṇairvṛtam ।। 7.35.33 ॥

translations.english: The enraged son of Simhika (Rahu), having gone to Indra's abode, spoke to the god (Indra) who was surrounded by hosts of gods, making a frown.
translations.hindi: अब पुनः देवताओं ओर राक्षसां का विकट युद्ध आरम्भ हुआ । दोनों ही ओर से मेथों से जलवृष्टि को तरह श्रां की वर्षा होने लगी

verses.sloka: बुभुक्षापनयं दत्त्वा चन्द्रार्कौ मम वासव ।किमिदं तत्त्वया दत्तमन्यस्य बलवृत्रहन् ।। ७.३५.३४ ॥
verses.transliteration: bubhukṣāpanayaṁ dattvā candrārkau mama vāsava ।kimidaṁ tattvayā dattamanyasya balavṛtrahan ।। 7.35.34 ॥

translations.english: O Vasava, O slayer of Bala and Vritra, having given the moon and sun to me as a means to satisfy my hunger, why have you now given them to another?
translations.hindi: हे राजन्‌ ! दुष्ट कुम्भकर्णं भी बहुत से श्न लिये हुए था, पर उसको यह ज्ञान न था, कि में किससे लडू अथवा उसे यह तऊ मालूम न हुआ कि विपक्षो कोन है

verses.sloka: अद्याहं पर्वकाले तु जिघृक्षुः सूर्यमागतः ।अथान्यो राहुरासाद्य जग्राह सहसा रविम् ।। ७.३५.३५ ॥
verses.transliteration: adyāhaṁ parvakāle tu jighṛkṣuḥ sūryamāgataḥ ।athānyo rāhurāsādya jagrāha sahasā ravim ।। 7.35.35 ॥

translations.english: Today, I had indeed arrived at the time of conjunction intending to seize the sun, but then another Rahu suddenly approached and seized the sun.
translations.hindi: अतः उसके आगे यदि कोई देवता पड़ जाता तो उसे बह्‌ दाँतों से,'लातों से, मूको से, शक्तियों से, तोमरों से ओर खुद रों से अथवा उस समय उसके हाथ जो वस्तु ( रणभूमि में ) आ जाती, उसीसे क्रोध में भर, मारने लगता था

verses.sloka: स राहोर्वचनं श्रुत्वा वासवः सम्भ्रमान्वितः ।उत्पपातासनं हित्वा चोद्वहन्काञ्चनीं स्रजम् ।। ७.३५.३६ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa rāhorvacanaṁ śrutvā vāsavaḥ sambhramānvitaḥ ।utpapātāsanaṁ hitvā codvahankāñcanīṁ srajam ।। 7.35.36 ॥

translations.english: Having heard Rahu's words, Vasava (Indra), filled with agitation, sprang up, abandoning his seat and still wearing his golden garland.
translations.hindi: इस बीच में रावण भी विश्वकर्मा के बनाए दिव्य रथ पर सवार हुआ

verses.sloka: ततः कैलासकूटाभं चतुर्दन्तं मदस्रवम् ।शृङ्गारधारिणं प्रांशुं स्वर्णघण्टाट्टहासिनम् ।। ७.३५.३७ ॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kailāsakūṭābhaṁ caturdantaṁ madasravam ।śṛṅgāradhāriṇaṁ prāṁśuṁ svarṇaghaṇṭāṭṭahāsinam ।। 7.35.37 ॥

translations.english: Then (Indra's elephant) appeared, resembling the peak of Kailasa, four-tusked, with ichor flowing, adorned with ornaments, tall, and making a loud sound with its golden bells.

verses.sloka: इन्द्रः करीन्द्रमारुह्य राहुं कृत्वा पुरःसरम् ।प्रायाद्यत्राभवत्सूर्यः सहानेन हनूमता ।। ७.३५.३८ ॥
verses.transliteration: indraḥ karīndramāruhya rāhuṁ kṛtvā puraḥsaram ।prāyādyatrābhavatsūryaḥ sahānena hanūmatā ।। 7.35.38 ॥

translations.english: Indra, having mounted his lordly elephant Airavata and making Rahu go before him, went to where the sun was, along with Hanuman.
translations.hindi: उंधर राक्षसी सेना को मंरुद्गणों के साथ विकट लड़ाई हो रही थी | मरुद्गण ने बिविध प्रकार के अत्र शानो से सारी राक्षसी सेना को भगा दि ।' ३७॥ केचिद्वि निहताः कृत्ताश्चेष्टन्ति स्म महीतले । बाहनेष्ववसक्तोशच स्थिता एवापरे रशे

verses.sloka: अथातिरभसेनागाद्राहुरुत्सृज्य वासवम् ।अनेन च स वै दृष्टः प्रधावञ्छैलकूटवत् ।। ७.३५.३९ ॥
verses.transliteration: athātirabhasenāgādrāhurutsṛjya vāsavam ।anena ca sa vai dṛṣṭaḥ pradhāvañchailakūṭavat ।। 7.35.39 ॥

translations.english: Then Rahu, leaving Indra, went with great speed, and he was indeed seen by Hanuman running swiftly like a mountain peak.

verses.sloka: ततः सूर्यं समुत्सृज्य राहुं फलमवेक्ष्य च ।उत्पपात पुनर्व्योम ग्रहीतुं सिंहिकासुतम् ।। ७.३५.४० ॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sūryaṁ samutsṛjya rāhuṁ phalamavekṣya ca ।utpapāta punarvyoma grahītuṁ siṁhikāsutam ।। 7.35.40 ॥

translations.english: Then, having completely left the sun and considering Rahu as a fruit, Hanuman again sprang into the sky to seize the son of Simhika.

verses.sloka: उत्सृज्यार्कमिमं राम प्रधावन्तं प्लवङ्गमम् ।अवेक्ष्यैवं परावृत्त्य मुखशेषः पराङ्मुखः ।। ७.३५.४१ ॥
verses.transliteration: utsṛjyārkamimaṁ rāma pradhāvantaṁ plavaṅgamam ।avekṣyaivaṁ parāvṛttya mukhaśeṣaḥ parāṅmukhaḥ ।। 7.35.41 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, having left the sun, Rahu, who has only a head remaining, turned away, averting his face after seeing this monkey (Hanuman) running swiftly.
translations.hindi: उस समय रणभूमि में मर कर अथबा अधमरे हो कर पड़े हुए राक्षसां से रणभूमि का अदूभुत दृश्य देख पड़ता था

verses.sloka: इन्द्रमाशंसमानस्तु त्रातारं सिंहिकासुतः ।इन्द्र इन्द्रेति संत्रासान्मुहुर्महुरभाषत ।। ७.३५.४२ ॥
verses.transliteration: indramāśaṁsamānastu trātāraṁ siṁhikāsutaḥ ।indra indreti saṁtrāsānmuhurmahurabhāṣata ।। 7.35.42 ॥

translations.english: Simhika's son, Rahu, desiring Indra as his protector, cried out "O Indra! O Indra!" repeatedly out of great fear.
translations.hindi: हत आहत सेनिकों के रक्त की नदी बहने लगी थी। वहाँ गीध और कोओं के झुंड के मुंड इकट्ट हा गर थे। उनमें शस्त्र रू मगर ( घड़ियाल ) देख पड़ते थे

verses.sloka: राहोर्विक्रोशमानस्य प्रागेवालक्षितं स्वरम् ।श्रुत्वेन्द्रोवाच मा भैषीरहमेनं निषूदये ।। ७.३५.४३ ॥
verses.transliteration: rāhorvikrośamānasya prāgevālakṣitaṁ svaram ।śrutvendrovāca mā bhaiṣīrahamenaṁ niṣūdaye ।। 7.35.43 ॥

translations.english: Having already perceived the voice of Rahu crying out, Indra said, "Do not fear; I will destroy him."
translations.hindi: अत्यन्त प्रतापवान्‌ रावण रकत! द्वारा अपनी समस्त राक्षसी सेना का नारा देख अत्यन्त क्र द्व हुआ

verses.sloka: ऐरावतं ततो दृष्ट्वा महत्तदिदमित्यपि ।फलं मत्वा हस्तिराजमभिदुद्राव मारुतिः ।। ७.३५.४४ ॥
verses.transliteration: airāvataṁ tato dṛṣṭvā mahattadidamityapi ।phalaṁ matvā hastirājamabhidudrāva mārutiḥ ।। 7.35.44 ॥

translations.english: Then, having seen Airavata, Maruta's son (Hanuman) thought, "This is a huge fruit," and rushed towards the king of elephants.
translations.hindi: बह्‌ देवसेना रूपो उमड़ते हुए सागर में तुरंत घुस पड़ा ओर देवताओं को मारता मारता इन्द्र के सामने जा पहुँचा

verses.sloka: तथास्य धावतो रूपमैरावतजिघृक्षया ।मुहूर्तमभवद्घोरमिन्द्राग्न्योरिव भास्वरम् ।। ७.३५.४५ ॥
verses.transliteration: tathāsya dhāvato rūpamairāvatajighṛkṣayā ।muhūrtamabhavadghoramindrāgnyoriva bhāsvaram ।। 7.35.45 ॥

translations.english: As he ran with the desire to seize Airavata, his form became terrible and shone brilliantly for a moment, like that of Indra and Agni.
translations.hindi: रात्रण को सामने देख, इन्द्र ने अपना विशाल धनुष टंकारा, जिसके टंकार का घोरशब्द दसो दिशाओं में प्रति- ध्वनित हुआ

verses.sloka: एवमाधावमानं तु नातिक्रुद्धः शचीपतिः ।हस्तान्तादतिमुक्तेन कुलिशेनाभ्यताडयत् ।। ७.३५.४६ ॥
verses.transliteration: evamādhāvamānaṁ tu nātikruddhaḥ śacīpatiḥ ।hastāntādatimuktena kuliśenābhyatāḍayat ।। 7.35.46 ॥

translations.english: Indra, Shachi's husband, though not excessively angry, struck him as he rushed forward with a thunderbolt released from his hand.

verses.sloka: ततो गिरौ पपातैष इन्द्रवज्राभिताडितः ।पतमानस्य चैतस्य वामो हनुरभज्यत ।। ७.३५.४७ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato girau papātaiṣa indravajrābhitāḍitaḥ ।patamānasya caitasya vāmo hanurabhajyata ।। 7.35.47 ॥

translations.english: Struck by Indra's thunderbolt, the child fell onto the mountain, and as he fell, his left jaw was broken.

verses.sloka: तस्मिंस्तु पतिते बाले वज्रताडनविह्वले ।चुक्रोधेन्द्राय पवनः प्रजानामहिताय सः ।। ७.३५.४८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasmiṁstu patite bāle vajratāḍanavihvale ।cukrodhendrāya pavanaḥ prajānāmahitāya saḥ ।। 7.35.48 ॥

translations.english: When the child, distressed by the thunderbolt's strike, fell, the wind god Vayu became angry at Indra, foreseeing harm to all creatures.

verses.sloka: प्रचारं स तु सङ्गृह्य प्रजास्वन्तर्गतः प्रभुः ।गुहां प्रविष्टः स्वसुतं शिशुमादाय मारुतः ।। ७.३५.४९ ॥
verses.transliteration: pracāraṁ sa tu saṅgṛhya prajāsvantargataḥ prabhuḥ ।guhāṁ praviṣṭaḥ svasutaṁ śiśumādāya mārutaḥ ।। 7.35.49 ॥

translations.english: The lord Vayu, having withdrawn his circulation from among all creatures, took his child and entered a cave.

verses.sloka: विण्मूत्राशयमावृत्य प्रजानां परमार्तिकृत् ।रुरोध सर्वभूतानि यथा वर्षाणि वासवः ।। ७.३५.५० ॥
verses.transliteration: viṇmūtrāśayamāvṛtya prajānāṁ paramārtikṛt ।rurodha sarvabhūtāni yathā varṣāṇi vāsavaḥ ।। 7.35.50 ॥

translations.english: Causing great distress to creatures by obstructing their excretory functions, he stopped all beings, just as Indra stops the rains.

verses.sloka: वायुप्रकोपाद्भूतानि निरुच्छ्वासानि सर्वतः ।सन्धिभिर्भिद्यमानैश्च काष्ठभूतानि जज्ञिरे ।। ७.३५.५१ ॥
verses.transliteration: vāyuprakopādbhūtāni nirucchvāsāni sarvataḥ ।sandhibhirbhidyamānaiśca kāṣṭhabhūtāni jajñire ।। 7.35.51 ॥

translations.english: Due to the wrath of Vayu, creatures everywhere became breathless, and with their joints splitting, they became like lifeless wood.

verses.sloka: निःस्वाध्यायवषट्कारं निष्क्रियं धर्मवर्जितम् ।वायुप्रकोपात्ऺत्रैलोक्यं निरयस्थमिवाभवत् ।। ७.३५.५२ ॥
verses.transliteration: niḥsvādhyāyavaṣaṭkāraṁ niṣkriyaṁ dharmavarjitam ।vāyuprakopātऺtrailokyaṁ nirayasthamivābhavat ।। 7.35.52 ॥

translations.english: Due to the wrath of Vayu, the three worlds became as if situated in hell, devoid of Vedic study, oblations, religious activities, and righteousness.

verses.sloka: ततः प्रजाः सगन्धर्वाः सदेवासुरमानुषाः ।प्रजापतिं समाधावन्दुःखिताश्च सुखेच्छया ।। ७.३५.५३ ॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prajāḥ sagandharvāḥ sadevāsuramānuṣāḥ ।prajāpatiṁ samādhāvanduḥkhitāśca sukhecchayā ।। 7.35.53 ॥

translations.english: Then, all beings including Gandharvas, Devas, Asuras, and humans, distressed and desiring happiness, rushed to Prajapati Brahma.

verses.sloka: ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयो देवा महोदरनिभोदराः ।त्वया नु भगवन्सृष्टाः प्रजानाथ चतुर्विधाः ।। ७.३५.५४ ॥
verses.transliteration: ūcuḥ prāñjalayo devā mahodaranibhodarāḥ ।tvayā nu bhagavansṛṣṭāḥ prajānātha caturvidhāḥ ।। 7.35.54 ॥

translations.english: With folded hands, the gods, whose bellies appeared distended from suffering, addressed Prajapati, saying, "O Lord of creatures, indeed, the four kinds of beings were created by you."

verses.sloka: त्वया दत्तो ऽयमस्माकमायुषः पवनः पतिः ।सो ऽस्मान्प्राणेश्वरो भूत्वा कस्मादेषो ऽद्य सत्तम ।। ७.३५.५५ ॥
verses.transliteration: tvayā datto 'yamasmākamāyuṣaḥ pavanaḥ patiḥ ।so 'smānprāṇeśvaro bhūtvā kasmādeṣo 'dya sattama ।। 7.35.55 ॥

translations.english: "This Vayu, the lord of our life, was given to us by you; why then, O best among the good, has he, having become the lord of our very breath, acted thus today?"

verses.sloka: रुरोध दुःखं जनयन्नन्तःपुर इव स्त्रियः ।तस्मात्त्वां शरणं प्राप्ता वायुनोहता वयम् ।। ७.३५.५६ ॥
verses.transliteration: rurodha duḥkhaṁ janayannantaḥpura iva striyaḥ ।tasmāttvāṁ śaraṇaṁ prāptā vāyunohatā vayam ।। 7.35.56 ॥

translations.english: "He has obstructed us, causing sorrow, just as women are confined in a harem; therefore, we, afflicted by Vayu, have sought refuge in you."

verses.sloka: एतत्प्रजानां श्रुत्वा तु प्रजानाथः प्रजापतिः ।कारणादिति चोक्त्वासौ प्रजाः पुनरभाषत ।। ७.३५.५७ ॥
verses.transliteration: etatprajānāṁ śrutvā tu prajānāthaḥ prajāpatiḥ ।kāraṇāditi coktvāsau prajāḥ punarabhāṣata ।। 7.35.57 ॥

translations.english: Having heard this from the people, Prajapati, the lord of creation, then spoke to them again, saying "due to the reason."

verses.sloka: यस्मिंश्च कारणे वायुश्चुक्रोध च रुरोध च ।प्रजाः शृणुध्वं तत्सर्वं श्रोतव्यं चात्मनः क्षमम् ।। ७.३५.५८ ॥
verses.transliteration: yasmiṁśca kāraṇe vāyuścukrodha ca rurodha ca ।prajāḥ śṛṇudhvaṁ tatsarvaṁ śrotavyaṁ cātmanaḥ kṣamam ।। 7.35.58 ॥

translations.english: Prajapati then instructed the people to listen to the entire beneficial reason for which Vayu became angry and caused obstruction.

verses.sloka: पुत्रस्तस्यामरेशेन इन्द्रेणाद्य निपातितः ।राहोर्वचनमास्थाय ततः स कुपितो ऽनिलः ।। ७.३५.५९ ॥
verses.transliteration: putrastasyāmareśena indreṇādya nipātitaḥ ।rāhorvacanamāsthāya tataḥ sa kupito 'nilaḥ ।। 7.35.59 ॥

translations.english: Vayu's son was struck down by Indra, the lord of immortals, today, acting upon the advice of Rahu, which is why Vayu became enraged.

verses.sloka: अशरीरः शरीरेषु वायुश्चरति पालयन् ।शरीरं हि विना वायुं समतां याति दारुभिः ।। ७.३५.६० ॥
verses.transliteration: aśarīraḥ śarīreṣu vāyuścarati pālayan ।śarīraṁ hi vinā vāyuṁ samatāṁ yāti dārubhiḥ ।। 7.35.60 ॥

translations.english: The bodiless Vayu moves within and protects all bodies, for indeed, a body without Vayu becomes equal to a mere log of wood.

verses.sloka: वायुः प्राणः सुखं वायुर्वायुः सर्वमिदं जगत् ।वायुना सम्परित्यक्तं न सुखं विन्दते जगत् ।। ७.३५.६१ ॥
verses.transliteration: vāyuḥ prāṇaḥ sukhaṁ vāyurvāyuḥ sarvamidaṁ jagat ।vāyunā samparityaktaṁ na sukhaṁ vindate jagat ।। 7.35.61 ॥

translations.english: Vayu is the life-breath, Vayu is happiness, and Vayu is this entire world, for the world finds no happiness when completely abandoned by Vayu.

verses.sloka: अद्यैव च परित्यक्तं वायुना जगदायुषा ।अद्यैव ते निरुच्छ्वासाः काष्ठकुड्योपमाः स्थिताः ।। ७.३५.६२ ॥
verses.transliteration: adyaiva ca parityaktaṁ vāyunā jagadāyuṣā ।adyaiva te nirucchvāsāḥ kāṣṭhakuḍyopamāḥ sthitāḥ ।। 7.35.62 ॥

translations.english: Just today, the life-giver of the world, Vayu, has abandoned them, and just today, they remain breathless, like inanimate wooden walls.

verses.sloka: तद्यामस्तत्र यत्रास्ते मारुतो रुक्प्रदो हि नः ।मा विनाशं गमिष्याम अप्रसाद्यादितेः सुताः ।। ७.३५.६३ ॥
verses.transliteration: tadyāmastatra yatrāste māruto rukprado hi naḥ ।mā vināśaṁ gamiṣyāma aprasādyāditeḥ sutāḥ ।। 7.35.63 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, let us go to where Vayu, who is indeed causing us pain, resides, lest we, the sons of Aditi, meet destruction without appeasing him.

verses.sloka: ततः प्रजाभिः सहितः प्रजापतिः सदेवगन्धर्वभुजङ्गगुह्यकैः ।जगाम तत्रास्यति यत्र मारुतः सुतं सुरेन्द्राभिहतं प्रगृह्य सः ।। ७.३५.६४ ॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prajābhiḥ sahitaḥ prajāpatiḥ sadevagandharvabhujaṅgaguhyakaiḥ ।jagāma tatrāsyati yatra mārutaḥ sutaṁ surendrābhihataṁ pragṛhya saḥ ।। 7.35.64 ॥

translations.english: Then, Prajapati, accompanied by all beings, including gods, gandharvas, serpents, and guhyakas, went to where Vayu sat, holding his son who had been struck by the lord of gods.

verses.sloka: ततो ऽर्कवैश्वानरकाञ्चनप्रभं सुतं तदोत्सङ्गगतं सदागतेः ।चतुर्मुखो वीक्ष्य कृपामथाकरोत्सदेवगन्धर्वर्षियक्षराक्षसैः ।। ७.३५.६५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato 'rkavaiśvānarakāñcanaprabhaṁ sutaṁ tadotsaṅgagataṁ sadāgateḥ ।caturmukho vīkṣya kṛpāmathākarotsadevagandharvarṣiyakṣarākṣasaiḥ ।। 7.35.65 ।।

translations.english: Then, the four-faced Brahma, seeing the son, who shone with the radiance of the sun, fire, and gold, placed on Vayu's lap, then showed compassion along with the gods, gandharvas, rishis, yakshas, and rakshasas. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे पंचत्रिंशः सर्गः ।। 35 ।। Thus ends the thirty-fifth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
